annotations.text: Landing Page — the operator console. Pending-restart banner, now-playing + transport, audio outputs (toggle per sink), webhooks + delivery status, lyrics overlay, and the full config editor with sharp fields (listen addr, data dir, extra args) shown read-only.
First-run Setup — unauthenticated, admin credentials only. Appears when config.yaml has no web creds; writes them and hands off to sign-in. Everything else is configured after login.
Login — username + password, verified timing-safe, kept in a signed HttpOnly cookie (the Web Session).
Lyrics Overlay — transparent background (shown here over a sample scene). Current line emphasised with glow; adjacent lines dimmed. Anchor, size, colour and effect all come from the Overlay Config.
